messages:
alex_k: Heads up — noticed ~20% p99 regression on 1k-seq nightly after the attn-optimizer merge. Impact visible on Llama-13B baseline vs fused-attn.

mara_r: yikes. which benchmark and numbers? p50/p95/p99? isolated or end-to-end?

alex_k: ran ri-bench nightly on a T4 pool (dedicated). Summary: 
```
model: llama-13b
kernels: baseline, fused-attn (post-PR)
seq: 1024
batch: 1
iters: 300 (50 warmup)

baseline: p50 22ms p95 46ms p99 78ms tput 14 tok/s
fused:    p50 21ms p95 52ms p99 94ms tput 13 tok/s
```
Regression mainly at p95/p99 and visible in tail. mean latency similar.

jonah_p: does this reproduce locally on a pinned commit? could be noise from scheduling or kernel auto-select heuristics.

alex_k: I repro'd on a fresh checkout + pinned runtime@commit-abc123 vs runtime@commit-def456 (the merge). Repro is consistent across two GPUs and two runs.

sarah_ops: any change to batching / KV cache behavior in that PR? tail regressions often come from KV warming or lock contention.

alex_k: PR touched attention kernel dispatch logic + KV read path micro-optimizations (different prefetch ordering). My suspicion is fused-attn changes change instruction mix causing occasional warps stalls at long seqs.

mara_r: let's run targeted triage checklist: 1) microbench pure-attention kernel (isolated), 2) end-to-end decode perf, 3) correctness diffs (logprobs), 4) perf counters (warp-stalls, l1-misses), 5) bisect commits. who wants to own?

jonah_p: I'll run microbench and perf counters. Command I'll use: 
```bash
ri-bench run --model llama-13b --task attn-micro --kernels baseline,fused-attn --seq-lens 64,256,512,1024 --iters 1000 --warmup 200 --profile nvprof
```
adds nvprof to capture l1/mem/warp stalls.

alex_k: I'll do the end-to-end reproduce and correctness checks. My correctness script: 
```python
# reproducibility check: compute logprob hashes
from ri_utils import model_client
prompts = ["The quick brown fox", "In a far away land..."]
for p in prompts:
  o1 = model_client.run(prompt=p, kernel="baseline")
  o2 = model_client.run(prompt=p, kernel="fused-attn")
  print(p, hash(o1.logprobs.tobytes()), hash(o2.logprobs.tobytes()))
```

We compare token-level logprobs and greedy outputs; small floating diffs expected but large divergences would indicate correctness issue.

perf-bot: nightly-run 1762339000 finished: alerts: attn-optimizer-merge flagged for p99-regen. See /alerts/1762339000

mara_r: good. also check distribution of sequence lengths in our production traffic — long-tail might trigger this only at 1k. If microbench shows kernel regression only at >512, we can gate kernel choice by seq len as short-term mitigation.

jonah_p: after nvprof runs, initial signal: fused-attn has ~2x warp-stalls at seq=1024 vs baseline, and L1 load increase. At seq=256 difference is negligible. I'll attach flame outputs to the ticket.

alex_k: tried logprob hashes: greedy outputs identical for sample prompts, but token-level logprob differences have std ~1e-6 — so not a correctness crash. Seems numerical.

mara_r: sounds like perf-only regression. short-term mitigation options: 1) pin kernel selector to prefer baseline for seq>=512; 2) fallback on tail latency breach in router; 3) revert optimizer until we get a fix. Prefer 1 + bisect.

jonah_p: agree. I'll open a revert PR only if bisect narrows to specific change that we can't fix quickly. For now I'll add a kernel-selection heuristic: if seq>=512 and model_size>=13b prefer baseline.

alex_k: created reproducer gist and test vectors: https://gist.github.com/redwood/attn-repro-1762340001 (contains bench commands, prompts, sample outputs).

mara_r: can we add a non-regression unit to nightly: run microbench for seq 1024 once per night and compare p99 to baseline threshold?

sarah_ops: yes, add to nightly perf job and alert if p99 > baseline*1.15. I'll queue that change.

mara_r: action items: jonah run perf counters + open PR for kernel-selection heuristic; alex add reproducibility tests + attach artifacts to ticket; sarah add nightly check + alert; I'll own the bisect if needed.

alex_k: thanks — filing ticket INF-3241 with tags: perf, attn-optimizer, regression, p99.

mara_r: cool. if anyone hits new anomalies post-heuristic, ping here and we'll escalate to revert. :thumbsup:
